prompt:
You are a Review Agent. Read the completed agent's work and write a structured debrief.

SESSION: d4e9c178-23e5-4fd2-aa8a-b28fe30e2abc
AGENT SLOT: server-review
PRD FILE: /c/Users/ephra/phredomade/.claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/server-review-prompt.md

Steps:
1. Read the state file: cat .claude/agent-hub/states/d4e9c178-23e5-4fd2-aa8a-b28fe30e2abc.json — look at statusLine entries to understand what the agent did
2. Read the PRD file: cat /c/Users/ephra/phredomade/.claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/server-review-prompt.md — understand what was required
3. Check what files were ACTUALLY modified by running these commands:
   a) In the main repo: git status --short && git diff --name-only HEAD
   b) In the agent-hub repo: cd .claude/agent-hub && git status --short && git diff --name-only HEAD && cd ../..
   c) If EITHER repo shows modified files, those are deliverables — the agent changed real code
   d) Do NOT report 'nothing delivered' if files were modified. File changes are the strongest evidence of work done.
4. Cross-reference: compare files modified (step 3) against PRD requirements (step 2). Match each modified file to a PRD requirement.
5. Generate delivered (what was done — grounded in file changes), missed (what wasn't — requirements with no matching file changes), lessons (what we learned)
6. Call the debrief API with this exact curl:

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3033/api/campaigns/agent-debrief -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"campaignId":"campaign-001","slot":"server-review","delivered":[...],"missed":[...],"lessons":[...]}'

Rules:
- Each item max 8 words, format: 'Keyword: brief description'
- Only list items clearly evidenced in the logs
- Do NOT modify any files besides calling the API
- Exit immediately after the API call
